Outfit: 5 min; addons: several hours of hunting (or buying the items)

The rebels of {wiki:Meriana} fight against the pirates of Nargor. After gaining their trust in the {wiki:Meriana Quest}, {npc:Raymond Striker} gives you the pirate outfit. The first addon (sabre) is obtained by handing 300 pirate items to {npc:Duncan}; the second (hat) by handing {npc:Ariella} the items of the four pirate leaders.
Yo ho ho and a bottle of {item:Rum}! If you love the pirate life and despise freshwater sailors, this may be the right outfit for you. They say pirates roam the {wiki:Shattered Isles}...
No minimum level; 70+ recommended for hunting pirates.
{wiki:Meriana Quest} completed (it gives access to Nargor and is required for the outfit).
{item:Eye Patch|Eye Patches}, {item:Peg Leg|Peg Legs} and {item:Hook|Hooks} drop from all kinds of pirates. Hunt in Nargor and keep them from the start.
Duncan asks for the 300 items **in order**: first the 100 Eye Patches, then the 100 Peg Legs and finally the 100 Hooks.
The pirate leaders' items can also be **bought** from other players; Ariella accepts them just the same.

In **Liberty Bay**, go to the small peninsula **southeast** of the depot and talk to {npc:Captain Waverider}: {key:hi}, {key:peg leg}, {key:yes} (50 gp). He takes you to **Sabrehaven**, the rebels' village on the island of {wiki:Meriana|Meriana}, where all the NPCs of this quest are.
To return to Liberty Bay, go **south** of Sabrehaven and talk to {npc:Sebastian}: {key:hi}, {key:liberty bay}, {key:yes} (50 gp).
Ask Raymond Striker for the outfit
After completing the {wiki:Meriana Quest}, talk to {npc:Raymond Striker} in Meriana: {key:hi}, {key:pirate outfit}.
Go hunting pirates in Nargor (and back)

The pirates are in {wiki:Nargor}, west of Liberty Bay. In Meriana, go **south** of Sabrehaven and ask {npc:Sebastian} {key:hi}, {key:nargor}, {key:yes} (50 gp). To return, {npc:Sebastian} in Nargor takes you to Meriana ({key:meriana}, 50 gp) or to Liberty Bay ({key:liberty bay}, 100 gp).
Gather **100** {item:Eye Patch|Eye Patches} and tell Duncan {key:patch} and {key:yes}.
Gather **100** {item:Peg Leg|Peg Legs} and tell Duncan {key:leg} and {key:yes}.
Gather **100** {item:Hook|Hooks} and tell Duncan {key:hook} and {key:yes}. He gives you the password **firebird**.
Talk to {npc:Ariella} in the Meriana tavern: {key:hi}, {key:addon}, {key:task}, {key:yes} and {key:yes} again. She asks you for proof of the death of the four pirate leaders.

You need: {item:Lethal Lissy's Shirt} ({creature:Lethal Lissy}), {item:Ron the Ripper's Sabre} ({creature:Ron the Ripper}), {item:Brutus Bloodbeard's Hat} ({creature:Brutus Bloodbeard}) and {item:Deadeye Devious' Eye Patch} ({creature:Deadeye Devious}). To kill them you have to wait for the {wiki:Liberty Bay Raids|pirate leaders' raid} in Liberty Bay, or do the pirate task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest} with {npc:Raymond Striker}. You can also buy them. With Raymond Striker's task completed, the teleport to the leaders' hideout is in Nargor ({coord:31977,32853,1}); after the boss, go back the same way to {npc:Sebastian} in Nargor.
The pirate leaders are bosses and show up with other pirates. Go in a group or well prepared.
Hand in the items and receive the hat
With the 4 items, go back to {npc:Ariella} and say {key:task} and {key:yes}.
